result.summary: Expose the transaction version field in the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper. The new function btck_transaction_get_version returns CTransaction::version directly from a btck_Transaction pointer.
result.problem: Downstream consumers of libbitcoinkernel cannot read a transaction's version through the public interface without manually slicing and decoding serialized transaction data.
evidence: PR description: 'It completes the existing set of transaction accessors allowing clients to read the transaction version without slicing serialized bytes.'
Follows merged kernel accessor additions #36194 and #36207.
result.changed_since_previous: The implementation and scope remain unchanged from the previous version.
result.card: This pull request adds btck_transaction_get_version to the libbitcoinkernel C API and GetVersion to its C++ wrapper. Currently, external consumers of libbitcoinkernel must manually slice serialized transaction bytes to determine the version. The addition completes the basic transaction accessor set following recently merged accessors in PRs 36194 and 36207, and includes unit tests for multiple version values. No unresolved dependencies exist.

risk.why: A flaw in the accessor could return incorrect transaction version data to external libbitcoinkernel consumers.
